_comment: The ONLY price-like text the public project brief (/sales/clientinformationrequest/) may carry: the optional 'Approximate budget' question. Its six answers are peso BANDS the CLIENT picks to tell us what they expect to spend — client-stated budget bands, not prices (Barro quotes nothing on this page). scripts/check-brief-copy.js (ci-invariants CHECK 9, and tests/brief-budget.test.mjs) lets exactly this question through and holds every other string of FORMS.project_brief_v2 to the no-price-words rule; the definition's question must equal this file field for field. Nothing else on any public surface is allowed by this file: the catalogue, the content pages and the homepage keep their ban. To change a band, edit this file AND the `budget` field in js/cir-forms.js (then `cp js/cir-forms.js functions/cir-forms.js`) AND the pinned list in tests/brief-budget.test.mjs.
label: Approximate budget (optional)
hint: A rough range helps us suggest a scope that fits. Skip it if you prefer.

options.l: Prefer not to say / not sure
